name: track-hazard-detection-backend
description: Event-driven track hazard detection: store-and-forward edge ingest, a transactional outbox into partitioned Valkey Streams, a correlator (CEP) with event-time windows and watermarks, an alerting process manager with durable timers, replayable projections and a simulated notifier

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,relay,correlator,alerting,projector,notifier -c blue,gray,magenta,yellow,cyan,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:relay" "npm run dev:correlator" "npm run dev:alerting" "npm run dev:projector" "npm run dev:notifier"
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,relay,correlator,alerting,projector,notifier "tsx src/api/index.ts" "tsx src/relay/index.ts" "tsx src/correlator/index.ts" "tsx src/alerting/index.ts" "tsx src/projector/index.ts" "tsx src/notifier/index.ts"
